neighbours.label: the punctuation that closes a clause introducing another, further or contrasting point ('another difficulty, however,', 'another problem.', 'On the other hand,'): a 'here comes a further point' boundary
fire: The roof leaks badly. There is another issue, however, with the wiring.
Prices went up in March. There was another increase, however, in June.
The engine is fine. On the other hand, the brakes need work.
Our first trial failed. Another approach, however, worked well.
The museum is free on Sundays. There is another reason to visit, though.
The map was accurate. The guidebook, on the other hand, was outdated.
Sales grew in Europe. There is another market, however, that shrank.
The hotel was clean. Another complaint, however, concerned the noise.
quiet: The roof leaks badly. There is an issue with the wiring too.
Prices went up in March. They went up in June as well.
The engine is fine. The brakes need work.
Our first trial failed. The second trial worked well.
The museum is free on Sundays. Many families visit then.
The map was accurate. The guidebook was outdated.
Sales grew in Europe. The market in Asia shrank.
The hotel was clean. Some guests complained about the noise.
